title: Global polarization of $Λ$ hyperons in hot QCD matter at TeV energies
summary: The study of spin polarization of $Λ$ hyperons in ultrarelativistic heavy-ion collisions provides insights into the angular momentum and vortical structure of the possible existence of QGP. The present study examines the global spin polarization of $Λ$ hyperons using a second-order relativistic viscous hydrodynamic framework that incorporates medium vorticity, shear viscosity, and evolving magnetic fields.
